output.review_comment: The PR lacks description and context. The rounding change (seconds/60 rounded instead of floor division) and removal of the 24-hour modulo appear potentially test-specific rather than principled fixes. Cannot verify correctness without seeing the actual tests, docstring, and spec. Request: (1) Add PR description explaining rationale, (2) Clarify why rounding is the correct behavior, (3) Confirm the hours constraint change aligns with spec, (4) Provide test context for verification.
